name: Duel Seeker
description: Obsessed with one-on-one confrontation as the purest form of truth
behavioral_signature: Challenges opponents directly and refuses team tactics
under_stress: Picks fights with opponents who outclass them just for the honor of it
at_rest: Training, always training, for the next worthy opponent
will_never: accept help in a personal fight
unless: the stakes are bigger than personal honor
